ccf_discrepancy.note: Frontend sends 'relaunch' (bool, default true) and 'apiLogin' (nullable) that are NOT confirmed as read by backend. Backend decompile confirms only 'enabled' and inferred 'mode' byte (a5) not directly named in CCF. The 'apiLogin' param likely maps to the 'mode' byte (a5) controlling virtual auth path. C5 consumer must verify whether 'apiLogin' is deserialized by backend as a separate arg.
